summary: Maintainability of victim's Article 32 petition; PIL challenges to remission order; competence of State to grant remission; legality of remission under CrPC s.432(2); communal riots context; gang-rape/murder of pregnant victim; multiple family members killed; remission orders dated 10.08.2022 set aside; re-arrest directed; guidelines for remission exercise established; victim-centric justice prioritized over reformation in heinous crimes.
final_judgment: Remission orders quashed; convicts to be re-arrested within two weeks; guidelines issued for future remission exercises.
